build_overlay_text_transform: build a python module to overlay random text on a PIL image using OverlayTextTransform
create_font_repository: create a FontRepository instance that loads all TTF fonts from a directory path
load_font_from_ttf: load a Font object from a TTF file and its corresponding pickle charset file
sample_random_string: sample a random string of characters from a Font object's charset using sample_string
create_transform_from_config: create an OverlayTextTransform instance from a configuration dictionary with sampler settings
